items.name: ALL_KEYWORDS
items.summary: Array of all SQL keywords as string constants.

items.name: ALL_KEYWORDS_INDEX
items.summary: Array of all `Keyword` enum values in declaration order.

items.name: RESERVED_FOR_COLUMN_ALIAS
items.summary: Can't be used as a column alias, so that `SELECT <expr> alias` can be parsed unambiguously without looking ahead.

items.name: RESERVED_FOR_IDENTIFIER
items.summary: Global list of reserved keywords that cannot be parsed as identifiers without special handling like quoting. Parser should call `Dialect::is_reserved_for_identifier` to allow for each dialect to customize the list.

items.name: RESERVED_FOR_TABLE_ALIAS
items.summary: These keywords can't be used as a table alias, so that `FROM table_name alias` can be parsed unambiguously without looking ahead.

items.name: RESERVED_FOR_TABLE_FACTOR
items.summary: Global list of reserved keywords allowed after FROM. Parser should call Dialect::get_reserved_keyword_after_from to allow for each dialect to customize the list.

items.name: Keyword
items.summary: An enumeration of SQL keywords recognized by the parser.
